notes.title: Halloween-themed update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, hope you're doing well.
This year, I thought I should make a halloween themed update for this game, so here we are!

What changed?
- All multiplayer maps now are halloween themed, and contain pumpkins scattered through the level.
- The menu screen is now daker and scarier and the song is slowed down!
- In zombie mode, all zombies now have pumpkins on their head, which can be also shot down.
- The zombie map has also switched to night-time now, and is much more atmospheric.

This is just a dumb small change I made for fun, don't expect too much :D.
Happy halloween!

(Also, check out the patch notes for more detail!)

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Happy halloween!
This year, I thought I should make a halloween themed update for this game, so here we are!
Also, some bugs have been fixed and polished!

What changed?
- All multiplayer maps now are halloween themed, and contain pumpkins scattered through the level.
- The menu screen is now daker and scarier and the song is slowed down!
- In zombie mode, all zombies now have pumpkins on their head, which can be also shot down.
- The zombie map has also switched to night-time now, and is much more atmospheric.


Bug fixes / changes:
- In the zombie mode, weapons should now upgrade correctly. (hopefully fixed)
- You now start any match with just 1500 cash.
- Various adjustments to firing animations, and more overall weapon balance changes.

The store page will also soon be updated!

Thanks for playing! See you in the next update!

notes.title: The 2nd big update!
notes.notes:
Many things were improved and reworked and fixed!

Main updates:
- YOU CAN NOW HAVE 3 GUNS EQUIPPED AND SWITCH BETWEEN THEM!!
(this feature may be buggy, I still have to properly fix all the problems)

Other stuff:
- A bug where you would shoot completely off target when ADSing has been fixed
- Gunfire sounds were improved + guns now have an "echo effect" when fired
- You no longer drop weapons when killed. This should make it more fair for respawning players
- In the Zombies mode there are now waves, and you can now buy upgrades with money
- Some animations were remade/improved
- More screenshake has been added to more heavy weapons.
- Guns have been reworked to be more balanced
- Most prices have been reduced
- Your character no longer t-poses while holding some guns

I tried to fix the issue with multiplayer (only 2 players being able to join) but I didnt figure it out yet. So now, more players will be able to join the server, but I warn you that it may freeze the server until the 3rd guy leaves.

I worked really hard on all of these updates, and Ill work more on them to completely finish this game! Next i'll probably focus on Zombies/Story mode.

Stay tuned, and have fun playing Rifle Strike!

notes.title: A multiplayer hotfix for the previous update.
notes.notes:
in the recent patch, the client couldn't move properly after joining a server. This is now hopefully fixed. Tho you still have to play with max 2 players.

Also, a new weapon has been added, the Y-Kov!
Most of the animations will be reworked and improved though.

Thanks for all your support, have fun!

notes.title: The First Large Update - New AI, More Maps, Weapon Rework + More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I am finally coming with an update after two months of work. And there's a LOT that changed!

My main focus for this update was the AI bots. In singleplayer they are fine, but they never worked with more players in multiplayer. Because of this, i started from scratch and made a much better AI that actually plays like a player and works in matches. Please playtest these so I can start fixing them.
(the AI will improve over time, for now it's not 100% complete.)

Some new movement/gunplay changes:
About the gunplay, I completely removed movement inaccuracy when aiming down sights. It was just annoying so I got rid of it.
Also, i fixed you losing speed everytime you landed from a jump.
I now added visual recoil for some high caliber weapons.

Here are some balance weapon changes:
KA-74
 + visual recoil
 - has a new, less random recoil pattern
Model 4
 - recoil reduced, but made more random
L80
- recoil increased slightly
AS-BAU
- recoil now goes straight up without any randomness
M90
++ visual recoil
- recoil greatly increased
AVB
- recoil decreased
.45 SMG
- recoil greatly reduced
+ visual recoil
HR 74
- damage increased slightly
The Eagle
- recoil greatly reduced
++ visual recoil
P-9
- recoil increased, but less random

New additions:

- When there's enough players for a match, a countdown will start.
Players are unable to move or shoot until it counts down. Then, the match starts
and music plays (the music will 100% change, for now it's some no-copyright song
but later it will be OST)

Changes:
- Support helo now is 1st person instead of 3rd, and shoots differently.
However, it still isn't fully compatible with multiplayer, so it won't be
fully available until it is. (same with the AC-130)

- The max player count for a multiplayer match is now 2, because for some
reason the server crashes everytime a 3rd player joins. Until then, feel free to
play with bots + someone else.

Please give me feedback on this update! After this there will probably be a smaller patch to fix some bugs and stuff, and after that there will be more large updates!
Have a nice day and have fun playing Rifle Strike!

notes.title: New mission, matchmaking, weapons update!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the newest update! Sorry for the time it took me to release this, but it took a lot of time and work!
If you have any more suggestions, please comment and let me know!

What was added:
- A new bolt-action sniper rifle, the AVB
- A new shotgun, the M37
- A "Quick Play" button, that automatically joins you to an online/PvE match
- A new single-player mission "Shot from above"

Weapon balance changes:
- Sniper rifles (M90, AVB)
   - Now far more inaccurate until fully scoped in
- HR 74
   - Recoil slightly reduced
- .45 SMG
   - Recoil now less random

What was fixed:
- Fixed a bug, where if you entered a sp mission after playing the zombie mode,
you would not respawn, but die instantly
- Fixed a bug, where the crosshair wouldn't update in mission 3

Other changes:
- In mission 3, you now win by actually getting the files and escaping
- The files now have a texture and an arrow above indicating its location
- In the level select menu, you now can't go from level 0 all the way to level 5 by pressing "A", and otherwise. This was confusing for some people, so it was fixed.

notes.title: Second Patch!
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Major changes:
- Buy menu has been reworked, there are now categories.
- Some unfinished weapons have been removed.
- You can now bind a different key to a mechanic and change the controls.
- You can now change the overall volume in-game.

Balance Changes:
- Big damage increase for AS - BAU
- Small recoil decrease for the .45 SMG
- Small spread decrease for the .45 SMG

Small Changes / Fixes:
- Nicknames now appear above players in multiplayer.
- Support helo has been temporarily removed.
- You can now host/join a server after getting kicked into the main menu by the game.
- An "I need help" button has been added to the menu, leading to a video tutorial on how to play the game.

notes.title: First update based on suggestions!
notes.notes:
General:
- Graphic settings have been moved to a separate menu
- Controls are now shown in the new separate menu
- Graphic settings are now present in the pause menu
- The pause menu now can be accessed with ESC

Zombies:
- Your character no longer slides with no input when interacting with the Upgrades station
- Dead zombies no longer harm you
- When you die you no longer respawn, but die permanently.
- XP earned in this mode now counts towards the next rank properly.

Singleplayer Missions:
- The Siren in the first mission is now way quieter.
- Some voiceline's volume has been lowered.

The next big update will be bug fixes, and settings revamp!
